papers.title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
papers.authors: Jiayu Gu, Yiwei Wang, Jie Zhang, Guojun Cao, Keshen Lyu, Song Zhou, Yimeng Chen, Haorui Wang, Qingmin Feng, Shenchao Shi, Huan Zhao, Wenbin Chen, Caihua Xiong, Chidan Wan, Jing Samantha Pan, Xiong Cai, Han Ding
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, video segmentation, tracking, medical image, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院肝胆外科（机构1）；华中科技大学机械科学与工程学院（机构2）；中山大学心理学系（机构3）；华中科技大学同济医学院附属协和医院生物医学工程研究所（机构4）；华中科技大学医学装备科学与工程研究所（机构5）；武汉大学人民医院肝胆胰外科（机构6）
papers.intro: 本文提出DiffeoAfford框架，利用微分同胚约束的组织跟踪从已完成手术中回顾性生成动作锚定的组织affordance热图标签，训练实时预测模型并构建AffordView自动取景系统，在不需人工逐帧标注的情况下预测手术操作区域，显著降低外科医生术中认知负荷。

papers.title: Grounding Agentic VLMs with Dedicated Segmentation for Fine-Grained Vehicle Damage Assessment
papers.authors: Vishwajeet Shivaji Hogale, Anjali Pai, Nitya Ravi
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University
papers.intro: 本文提出TinyDamage混合架构，将空间定位委托给专用分割模型并以其输出显式接地VLM的生成步骤，将车辆损伤报告幻觉率从92%/78%降至31%，同时证明了损失函数选择对微小目标接地有决定性影响。

papers.title: Syntax Meets Semantics: Understanding Scientific Formulae
papers.authors: Yuni Susanti, Moritz Schubotz
papers.affiliations: FIZ Karlsruhe, Berlin, Germany（两位作者均属于该机构）
papers.intro: 论文系统实证研究了科学公式语法表示与语义表示之间的跨模态对应关系，发现两者在原生空间中直接对应极弱、但存在强潜在相关性，并证明使用对比学习可以显著恢复和增强这种跨模态对齐，大幅提升跨模态检索性能。

papers.title: MoRAL: Sensor-Grounded BEV Reasoning for Compact VLMs toward Edge-Oriented Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Ambarish Govindarajulu Kaliamurthi, Kaikai Liu
papers.affiliations: San José State University (SJSU), Computer Engineering Department
papers.intro: MoRAL提出一种两阶段微调流水线，通过将LiDAR距离、物体类别和雷达多普勒速度确定性渲染为BEV图像中的颜色和形状特征，使仅2B参数的紧凑VLM（Cosmos-Reason2-2B）在无学习式3D骨干的情况下，在驾驶空间推理任务上超过了零样本8B基线。

papers.title: Advancing Relevance Measurement with Vision-Language Models for Web-Scale Search
papers.authors: Han Wang, Alex Whitworth, Pak Ming Cheung, Zhenjie Zhang, Krishna Kamath, Xi Chen, Roberto Konow, Kurchi Subhra Hazra
papers.affiliations: Pinterest
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个基于微调视觉-语言模型（VLM）的自动化相关性评估流水线，部署于Pinterest搜索的在线A/B实验中，显著缩短标注周期、扩大查询覆盖、降低测量方差并将实验可感知的最小影响幅度（MDE）缩减至原来的1/6，同时保持与人工标注的高度对齐。

papers.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
papers.authors: Dunjie Lu, Shuai Bai, Tianyi Bai, Sicheng Fan, Chang Gao, Jian Guan, Feng Hu, Mianqiu Huang, Xingyang Huang, Yizhen Jiang, Yuheng Jing, Dehui Kong, Ning Li, Dayiheng Liu, Shixuan Liu, Zheng Liu, Que Shen, Bowen Wang, Junli Wang, Chencan Wu, Rui Xie, Tianbao Xie, Zhihui Xie, Haiyang Xu, An Yang, Tao Yu, Wenzhen Yuan, Xi Zhang, Zhenru Zhang, Mingkang Zhu, Zhaoqing Zhu, Yizhong Cao, Kai Dang, Binyuan Hui, Kaixin Li, Junyang Lin, Haiquan Wang, Zekun Wang, Yiheng Xu, Fan Yan, Mengqi Yuan, Danyang Zhang, Jiajun Zhang, Zhipeng Zhang, Fan Zhou, Fan Zhou
papers.affiliations: Qwen Team（阿里云）与 Xlang Lab
papers.intro: Qwen-CUA 是一个基于 Qwen 混合专家模型的纯截图输入、键盘鼠标输出的原生计算机使用智能体，通过大规模可验证交互训练和长程视觉上下文管理，在八项基准上超越前代模型并接近领先闭源系统。

papers.title: GenPrior: Unleashing Text-to-Motion Generative Priors for Zero-Shot Skeleton-based Action Recognition
papers.authors: Jidong Kuang, Hongsong Wang, Jie Gui
papers.affiliations: 东南大学（Southeast University），紫金山实验室（Purple Mountain Laboratories）
papers.intro: GenPrior是首个利用预训练文本到运动（T2M）生成模型作为外部运动先验来源的零样本骨架动作识别框架，通过将生成运动的结构信息自适应注入文本语义并细化类原型，显著缓解语义-运动学差距，在零样本和广义零样本设定下均达到最先进性能。

papers.title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
papers.authors: Zhongjie Ba, Shengwang Xu, Peng Cheng, Jinyang Zou, Ting Yu, Zhibo Wang, Zhan Qin
papers.affiliations: - Zhongjie Ba - State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou, China; Hangzhou High-Tech Zone (Binjiang) Institute of Blockchain and Data Security, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China
papers.intro: 论文提出PhyCheck——一个细粒度、证据锚定的视频问答数据集，用于系统评估和提升Video-LLMs对物理定律的理解，通过多粒度问题和上下文敏感子集揭示模型在反物理异常上的严重弱点，并验证了基于该数据的微调能显著改善物理一致性理解。

papers.title: CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Wei Jia, Zhicong Lu, Yu Chen, Xiang Wang, Shuai Li, Wenqian Lv, Jiayue Cao, Huaxing Liu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: AMAP, Alibaba Group；University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: CAVE 通过引入边界专用证据 token、轻量监督热启动，以及在强化学习中设计视觉边界证据对齐奖励与能力感知门控，将 LVLM 在 VTG 任务中的“视觉边界证据”与“预测时间戳”显式对齐，从而缓解证据–时间戳错位并提升时序定位精度。

papers.title: TBSG-Net: Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph Network for Fine-Grained Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Ji Huang, Yongsheng Dai, Tianyu Ren, Barry Devereux, Hui Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Electronics, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Queen's University Belfast, Belfast, Northern Ireland
papers.intro: TBSG-Net首次将动态场景图（Dynamic Scene Graph, DSG）引入视频时刻检索，通过构建带有显式时间跨度属性的时间二分场景图（Temporal Bipartite Scene Graph, TBSG），并利用Transformer与GCN混合编码器建模全局事件和局部关系，显著提…

papers.title: Invisible Ink Threats: Adversarial Goals Behind Legitimate Tasks in Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Jia-Chen Zhang, Ze-Yu Zhang, Kai-Wei Zhang
papers.affiliations: East China Normal University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文揭示并系统研究了计算机使用代理在面对“隐形墨水威胁”——即伪装成合法任务的低危害间接提示注入攻击——时的严重脆弱性，并提出了攻击基准II-Bench和测试框架HITLCUA来评估和揭示这一风险。

papers.title: TRAM: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Trajectory-Derived Auxiliary Memory
papers.authors: Kang Liu, Zijing Wang, Yongkang Liu, Mengjie Zhao, Xiaocui Yang, Shi Feng, Yifei Zhang, Daling Wang
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University, China
papers.intro: TRAM是一种无需训练的解码增强方法，通过从模型自身推理轨迹中提取并在线更新紧凑的“双时标递归记忆”，再将其注入到选定解码层，从而在长轨迹推理中保留并复用早期推理信息，提升多模态推理准确率。

papers.title: CRAFT: Compression via Recursive Adaptive Fusion of Video Tokens for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yu Chen, Xiaohong Li, Xiaole Wang, Jianjin Zhang, Jun Sun, Yafeng Deng
papers.affiliations: Evermind（盛大集团），Shanda Group（盛大集团），Peking University（北京大学）
papers.intro: CRAFT 提出了一种递归“先选择后融合”的视频 token 压缩方法，通过免训练的全局相似度选择与可学习的门控融合相结合，在约 8 倍压缩时保留骨干模型约 97% 的平均准确率，并显著降低 prefill 时延和计算量。

papers.title: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Ganzhong Luo, Yang Ren, Hanyong Wang, Shuyu Zheng, Menglong Yang
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, image retrieval, CLIP
papers.affiliations: School of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Sichuan University（四川大学航空航天学院）
papers.intro: UniHEAR 提出一个统一轻量级异构源实体检索与重排框架，通过粗检索描述符显式桥接粗检索与细粒度重排，并利用检索引导的注意力模态门控与熵加权源融合，在E-VQA和InfoSeek上取得SOTA检索与VQA性能。

papers.title: VespaSeg: A Resource-Aware Ground-then-Segment Pipeline for Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.authors: Savindu Dilshan Wickramasinghe
papers.tags: visual grounding, instance segmentation, Segment Anything, object detection
papers.affiliations: Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering, University of Moratuwa, Moratuwa, Sri Lanka
papers.intro: VespaSeg 提出了一种“先定位（grounding）后分割（segment）”的模块化指代表达分割流程，利用紧凑视觉语言模型（Florence-2 或 Moondream2）生成目标框，再用 MobileSAM 完成掩码预测，并通过 LoRA 适配和图像嵌入缓存实现精度与资源消耗的良好平衡。

papers.title: PHA-Net: Prototype-based Hierarchical Alignment Network for Text-Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Xiaolun Jing, Kezhao Yin, Xinxing Yang, Genke Yang, Jian Chu
papers.affiliations: Ningbo Artificial Intelligence Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Department of Biomedical Engineering, Oregon Health & Science University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于原型（Prototype）的层级对齐网络PHA-Net，通过模态共享原型作为桥梁，结合原型支持的Token合并与原型对比损失，实现文本和视频在个体、局部、全局三个层级的联合高效对齐，从而显著提升文本-视频检索性能。

papers.title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Chengbo Liu, Lifang Zhou, Ruijie Yan, Pei Tan, Ao Sun, Haojun Huang, Guichun Hua, Sining Wei, Yining Chen, Yingying He, Yutao Xie
papers.affiliations: Microsoft（中国北京）；东南大学（中国南京）
papers.intro: RMSWeb 提出一套面向 Web Agent 强化学习的三部分配方——反射条件数据采集、失败模式挖掘和 Salvage-DS 离线 RL 算法，在 Qwen3-VL 8B/32B 上以更少动作步数显著超越 SFT 策略，并在 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web、WebTailBe…

papers.title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
papers.authors: Meibo Hu, Guohao Sun, Annemarie D. Ross, Sheng Li, Zhiqiang Tao
papers.affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology, University of Virginia, National Technical Institute for the Deaf / Rochester Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 提出AttnSign，一种通过空间注意力监督和基于强化学习的运动节律引导，将通用VLM适配为端到端手语翻译器的训练框架，显著提升翻译质量和注意力可解释性。

papers.title: HierDoc: Hierarchical Page-to-Region Evidence Routing for Long-Document Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Rongjian Gu, Wengang Zhou, Junyu Xiong, Yonghui Wang, Bing Yin, Bei Wang, Houqiang Li
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China（中国科学技术大学）、iFLYTEK Research（科大讯飞研究院）、Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co. Ltd.（安徽省交通规划设计研究总院股份有限公司）
papers.intro: HierDoc提出一个层级证据路由框架，将长文档VQA的证据获取建模为"页面→区域"两阶段集合预测，用阶段式GRPO分别优化两级策略，再让答案模型联合消费选中的整页、区域裁剪和OCR/表格文本，以同时保留全局上下文和细粒度证据。

papers.title: OASIS: Occlusion-aware Single-image Hand Avatar Reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhisheng Han, Shiyao Wu, Jiayan Qiu, Yakun Ju, Lu Liu, Le Zhang, Pengfei Feng, Huiyu Zhou, Zheheng Jiang
papers.affiliations: University of Leicester, UK; University of Exeter, UK; University of Birmingham, UK; China University of Geoscience, Wuhan, China
papers.intro: 本文提出OASIS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）的单图手部化身重建框架，通过几何对齐视觉证据编码、可见性条件注意力以及Feature-on-Mesh表示，实现高效、高保真且可动画化的单视角手部重建。
